title: A portfolio with an option overlay: the speaker's virtual trading desk plan
summary: A promotional clip. The speaker plans a virtual trading desk with education and software tools to find trades, manage them and build a portfolio with an option overlay. He traded OTC derivatives for about 25 years and his team built its own tools. The chart shows the core-plus-overlay portfolio he describes.

steps.caption: The core: long-term holdings that carry most of the portfolio.
The option overlay: a smaller sleeve of option trades on top of the core.
Scenario tools show the worst case of the overlay before you add a trade.
The idea: a process to find, manage and size trades, not single alerts.

takeaways: The speaker contrasts a process with tools against groups that sell trade alerts.
Portfolio first, option overlay on top.
caveats: Promotional: the clip advertises the speaker's website, community and tools. Nothing here is a verified result.
